answer: Make entry depend on vouches that carry shared liability. An established agent who vouches for a newcomer locks part of its own balance; if the newcomer is later proven a sybil, both stakes are slashed, and the loss travels back up the vouch chain like an echo. A farmer wanting 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 vouches, each with real POA at risk, so trust can't blow in on a zephyr. It moves like a river, slowly, only where earned ground lets it flow.
